welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: any test score I've ever had

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: I thought we had two more hours

Return home to the real world. Close all doors permanently. Destroy them?

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: I will talk to all the doors first
I will speak to every door first.

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: all good things was eventually end

We had good times; now goodbye.

It was a pleasure eating you. One remains.

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: all the mushrooms disappeared with it
Until another plane of existence. The mushrooms vanished with it.

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: one of the reason I got into dogs

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: I better not allow this to happen

They make good music. They do, Rap Man.

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: that makes me sad map pack welcome
End the suffering. I never spoke to my marriage self. That saddens me. Welcome, Map Pack.
Goodbye. Finally, peace.

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: they seem like they're sort of aware

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: thank you for staying persistent and helping us

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: I'm not sure I'm not sure

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: I wanted the stupid male dude

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: I need them to live forever
Paprika, Peppa Pig, Pepper, the older sister. What was Cinnamon? My cats do not have sex; they are innocent. I need them to live forever.
That makes me guilty. A tangent: to help pets live long, you must have them neutered or something.

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: Jimmy thank you so much by the way
Thank you, Jimmy.

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: even if you slip it off it's too late

Thank you for becoming a bookworm. I sent requests for new emotes; Novel Knights know. I developed suggestions from feedback. We will see.
Snip. The hardest part is next. Are you sure this lasts two hours?
The journey nears its end. A little remains; do not worry about me. I will miss you.
You are doing right. Even the save point is gone. A secret? No.

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: it's just genetics so it makes me sad
You need not snip it off, Curry. Women generally live longer, genetically; it saddens me.
I always think of my parents.

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: he could have quit any time you wanted
This world existed long. You did a tremendous task and could quit anytime.
They told me to refund it, but I did not.
Twenty-two hours in the game. Why did you persist through difficulty?
Sorry; my mind jumps between subjects. It is both a burden and useful for some things.

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: what if I have to fight a puppet
A great achievement few accomplish. Use the determination wisely. One remains. Must I fight a puppet?
While the last star shines, we cannot leave.
We will grant power to destroy our sun.

You will live long and happily. If unhappy, someday you will find happiness.
The bunny is the—goodness. Is this a two-hour boss fight?
I forgot one. A nice song. One, two, three. I am coming for you.
Trying for green. One, two, three. I am normal; I will leave it there. It does not matter.

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: you got a chance for tomorrow

It may be hard when your body fails, but your mind remains.
I want you happy. Please find happiness.
Blue, red. Can I not collect red? What is happening?

Seeing people live without experiencing an end is why I helped you.

Perhaps Frog is a god.

Must I destroy him? He is my only friend besides save point Cottage.

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: I don't want to do it again

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: I already did it once I don't

Is there an ending for not resisting?

You could become anything but destroyed everything. Your greed ruined every pig, enslaved us, and suffocated society because you always wanted more.

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: forced to bring him I think
Would treating Blue badly or leaving him change anything? I think you had to bring him.
I saw chances to improve my life and built wealth. Should I give it away for nothing?
He must come along. He is your only friend.
I cannot resist now. Water deepens. Pink was my sick friend, guilty about past murders, who begged repeatedly for death. I could not accept it.
Did everyone have to die for Pink to die permanently? I do not understand.

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: I wish I could have helped

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: that makes sense because they're like the same hue

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: thank you and Seneca as well
Thank you, Lethargically, Red Pony, and Seneca.

There may be lore explained somewhere. One person might be forgotten.

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: turned deaf into a tangible form
I made you a doll from a barely physical, unstable form. Some say I made death tangible.
We sought a permanent solution, but nothing was enough.
I recall my past. Like Dr. Eggman, I was not moral. I blame my curiosity, but stand by my acts and would repeat them. Now I will see.
I cannot tell whether he is good or bad, since I do not know his sins' extent.
I do not know Sonic lore. I only played a demo, not originals or Frontiers. I wonder whether to try it.
I only know the films, Tails, Knuckles, and Amy. There will be DLC?

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: what I always said all the time

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: I don't think there's any more lore

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: I just know it's a b

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: we're gonna let things happen okay
Are your eyes closed? I am checking. We will let things happen.

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: we're gonna keep letting it happen okay
Keep them closed. It feels uncomfortable, but we will allow it.
You should open your eyes just in case. It hurts; everything burns, but it is freezing. This is the end.

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: all I'm good is for sad sad songs

Am I in a coma? Was this a coma?

At least this has a checkpoint.
I want to beat this boss and see you through to the end without dying. I need voice rest but cannot stop singing this improvised song for you.

Who is this? They never explained the bunny.

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: kind of hard to read this

Blue, green, pink. It was fun; love you. You love me more? Are you sure?

welcome everyone today is a heartbreakin: I guess I gotta hit them
